svg.title: Model weights, KV cache, runtime workspace, and the OS all draw from one Apple Silicon memory pool.
svg.desc: On Apple Silicon, model weights, the KV cache and runtime workspace, and macOS with its multimodal components all share one unified memory pool; peak memory equals the sum of all four, so headroom below sustained swap decides whether a model is actually usable, not just loadable.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: CPU and GPU share one pool — weights, cache, and the OS all draw from it.
